title: Positive-unpaired cleanup and delayed repayment on finite pair-transfer graphs
statement_preview_not_a_proof: For any finite directed pair-transfer graph of m disjoint C3 blocks with positive raw constants,and each fixed H,there exist eps,n0 such that A_i<=H,n=min_i(B_i-C_i)>=n0,sum_i C_i<=eps*n admit E[sigma+Jnc+Zout^2]<=Zin^2,with Z=7m+1+M-sum_i
